name: firls
comment: Sig: b = firls(N, F, A). Type-I least-squares FIR design with piecewise-linear desired amplitude. Cholesky on (M+1)x(M+1) Q matrix from closed-form integrals of cos(i*w)*cos(j*w) over each band. Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b on lowpass design (21-tap, [0,0.4]/[0.5,1] bands). NOTE: only Type-I (even N) supported in this revision; Type-III/IV (Hilbert, differentiator) and per-band weights are deferred.
